$comment: TESTIMONIALS — what people Moses has worked with say, each with where
a reader can check it.
Empty until someone has agreed to be quoted. While it is empty the
homepage shows nothing at all: no heading, no 'coming soon'.
THE RULE (scripts/lib/content.js, checkTestimonials, fails the build):
a quote without a source is not shown, because anyone can write a kind
sentence and put a name under it. Each entry is
"relationship": "...", "source": { ... } }
and the source is one of
{ "type": "linkedin", "url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/.../details/recommendations/" }
the recommendation as LinkedIn shows it: a linkedin.com profile
or recommendations address, nothing else
{ "type": "on-request", "permissionDate": "YYYY-MM-DD" }
not public; Moses holds it and will put a reader in touch. The date
is the day the person agreed to be quoted on this site
`relationship` says how they know his work ("managed me at ...").
At most three entries, each quote an excerpt of at most 200 characters.
The homepage has a length budget: two such quotes fit it today, a third
needs room made first (checkTestimonials says what each one costs).
npm run build:content draws them under the experience section.
